<document id="savings-pockets">
HowˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆSavingsˆPocketsˆareˆseparateˆbalancesˆinsideˆyourˆaccountˆthatˆearnˆinterest.ˆYouˆcanˆhaveˆupˆtoˆ10ˆofˆthem,ˆeachˆwithˆitsˆownˆnameˆandˆgoal.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆpocketˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket.ˆNameˆit,ˆsetˆaˆgoalˆifˆyouˆlike,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆin.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆMovingˆmoneyˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆyourˆpocketsˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree,ˆeveryˆday.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆhowˆmanyˆtimesˆyouˆcanˆwithdrawˆfromˆaˆpocket.ˆ##ˆInterestˆAllˆyourˆpocketsˆearnˆtheˆAPYˆforˆyourˆplan:ˆ0.50%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ2.00%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ3.75%ˆonˆPremium.ˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆ##ˆSpendingˆfromˆaˆpocketˆYourˆcardˆspendsˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance,ˆnotˆfromˆpockets.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆbackˆfirst.ˆ##ˆClosingˆaˆpocketˆTapˆtheˆpocket,ˆthenˆClose.ˆAnyˆmoneyˆandˆaccruedˆinterestˆmoveˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-apy-premium-v2">
SavingsˆrateˆonˆPremiumˆOnˆtheˆPremiumˆplan,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆearnˆ3.75%ˆAPY,ˆeffectiveˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆ-ˆTheˆrateˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ-ˆInterestˆcompoundsˆdailyˆandˆisˆpaidˆmonthly.ˆ-ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆpocketˆtoˆearnˆit.ˆ-ˆThere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆlimitˆonˆwithdrawals.ˆ##ˆRatesˆareˆvariableˆWeˆmayˆchangeˆtheˆrate.ˆWe'llˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆaˆdecrease.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆstartˆearningˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆinˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆinˆandˆoutˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree.ˆInterestˆforˆeachˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆtheˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplansˆYourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆUpgradesˆtakeˆeffectˆrightˆawayˆandˆdowngradesˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-apy-plus-v2">
SavingsˆrateˆonˆPlusˆOnˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆearnˆ2.00%ˆAPY,ˆeffectiveˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆ-ˆTheˆrateˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ-ˆInterestˆcompoundsˆdailyˆandˆisˆpaidˆmonthly.ˆ-ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆpocketˆtoˆearnˆit.ˆ-ˆThere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆlimitˆonˆwithdrawals.ˆ##ˆRatesˆareˆvariableˆWeˆmayˆchangeˆtheˆrate.ˆWe'llˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆaˆdecrease.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆstartˆearningˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆinˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆinˆandˆoutˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree.ˆInterestˆforˆeachˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆtheˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplansˆYourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆUpgradesˆtakeˆeffectˆrightˆawayˆandˆdowngradesˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆ##ˆEarnˆmoreˆPremiumˆmembersˆearnˆ3.75%ˆAPYˆonˆtheˆsameˆbalance.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
